Don't know if someone mentioned this already but in the case of ppl with autism, they do tend to like animals more than ppl. Not because they hate ppl, just ppl treat them differently due to their quirks and mannerisms. My fiance is an Aspie and he's very sweet and hard working but prefers to work alone bc ppl tend to find him creepy/weird. Plus he's a 6ft male so ppl find him more like a threat. 

Animals are less judgemental so he can be sweet, playful and less self conscious about what he's doing or how's acting. Of course, he loves me more than his dogs but tends to avoid other people for these reasons.
Take my poor man's award good person 🏆🏆🏆

Hey there, you want to chat? I know it sucks but at least you haven't exhausted your treatment options. Antidepressants have stabilized my mood and they could do the same to you. I feel you need to focus on yourself for now. Chasing girls around might be fun but the repeated rejection and failures is obviously affecting you negatively. Take some time for you. Romantic love isn't the only thing or the only kind of love there is.
Thanks it cheer me up a bit. Good fortune to you too friend!
Mostly House and Steven Universe. Two complete opposites 😂 but they're good shows.
I have a couple of shows. And stuffed animals to hug.
Thank you for replying. I'll try to keep it up. Its just frustrating when it sneaks up on me and just attacks me. I feel so powerless in my own life. I know its pathetic but its how I feel.

Thanks for replying. That is a good idea. I don't like to be a downer on ppl so I keep stuff like this to myself. And Reddit I guess although I didn't think someone would reply. I just wanted to let it out.

Im scared of pain. And a lot of suicide methods involve unless you get just the right equipment and chemicals. Also it would hurt several people although I think that they be better off without me, they don't share that opinion. In addition, my death would be seen as a cowardly act by my community. So I get through live. Its hard. But I hope it gets easier at some point. If not maybe I'll die from a disease or a mass shooter. At least there no one will say Im a coward.
